candidates.snippet:
-The RFN vessels continued to sail eastward through Soya Strait.
-JMSDF assets monitored the activities of the vessels.

ABBREVIATIONS
JMSDF: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force
RFN: Russian Federation Navy
CG: Guided Missile Cruiser
AGM: Missile Range Instrumentation Ship

-At around 5:00 a.m., Wednesday, September 23, 2026, JMSDF spotted RFN Slava-class CG x 1 (hull number 011) and Marshal Nedelin-class AGM x 1 (hull number 331) sailing northeastward in the waters approximately 60 km west of Rebun Island.
The activity of Russian Navy vessels in the waters surrounding Japan. https://t.co/wkK4hhWPSG
